findings.reason: §1's done-when requires the node to re-run the census and confirm every hit is in one of the three states, so a named hit that satisfies none of them either fails the node's gate or is exempted silently, and the fix is one line — drop the guard clause, or record each of these two paths as an owned-elsewhere exception beside the state it is asking the node to check.
findings.text: the changed census end-state is wrong for two of the file-level hits it names: `scripts/figures_jt60sa_signals.py:35` is placed in state 1 ("reads the /work data store … and guarding its absence") but the 61-line script resolves `PULSE_FILE` at import and passes it straight to `imas.DBEntry(...)` in `_main()` with no guard, so a missing store raises rather than being guarded; and `scripts/vacuum_loop_adjudication.py` is cited at `:1186`/`:1217` as a data-store reader while `:1088` (`JT60SA_COIL_MAP`) makes the same file a map reader that §1 separately moves to the bundle resolver — the census command selects per file (`git grep -l`), so that file must satisfy two states at once, and its map read cannot take state 2's "skips with a stated reason" because it is a script, not a test

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — neither unit adds a module; §1 removes two store-root role names from `imas_ambix/data/bundle.py` and §11 ships no new interface, so there is nothing for a deep-module test to fail on.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — §1 retires the machine-named role names `JT60SA_ROOT` and `JT60SA_DESCRIPTION_DIR` from `imas_ambix/data/bundle.py` `_STORE_ROOTS`, leaving `imas_ambix/data/paths.py` as the single owner of the `/work` layout and `eddb_cache` (`bundle.py:22`, valued from `paths.JT60SA_ROOT`) as the role the writer resolves.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — supplied counts public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; both changed units retire surface (§1 removes the two store-root role names) and add none (the §11 netcdf extra and the py312 ruff pin are packaging and configuration, not a definition, CLI option, MCP view or refusal family), so no addition needs accounting for.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the census command is reproducible (`git grep -l -E "jt-60sa|JT60SA_ROOT|JT60SA_DESCRIPTION_DIR|/work/projects/imas_gpu/jt60sa" -- imas_ambix scripts tests packages ':!*.json'` returns 20 files at 92813b57, matching the plan's list) but the end-state the changed text assigns two named census hits does not hold for them.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — §1's map read in `scripts/vacuum_loop_adjudication.py:1088` moves onto the existing by-name resolver `load_packaged_signal_map` (`packages/imas-alambic/src/imas_alambic/signal_map.py:638`), not onto a new wrapper; `SignalMap.signals` carries `source_array` and `target_index`, so the call site's ordering can be rebuilt from it.
